title: Medieval Tower in Rome Partially Collapses, Trapping Worker Who Is Later Freed
summary: Rescuers at the tower near the Colosseum worked for 11 hours before removing the man who had been pinned under rubble and debris. He was seriously hurt.

title: In China Truce on Tariffs and Rare Earths, National Security Controls Are Bargaining Chip
summary: Some analysts say Beijing won a major victory in its trade talks: Getting the U.S. to withdraw a national security measure that previously was not under discussion.

title: Lawmakers say stolen police logins are exposing Flock surveillance cameras to hackers
summary: Flock said around 3% of its law enforcement customers do not use multi-factor authentication, potentially exposing dozens of law enforcement agency accounts open to compromise and improper access.

title: US family sues Tesla, alleging wrongful death due to faulty doors
summary: The lawsuit, filed on Friday, alleges lithium-ion battery pack in Model S caused the electronic door systems to fail.
